prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1147; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented after a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a wrist injury. Imaging and examination were consistent with a distal radius fracture, and the mechanism described is a plausible cause of this type of injury. Over three visits the patient was managed with immobilization, pain control, and scheduled follow-up. Some examination findings, including tenderness and reduced grip strength, support the diagnosis, while other tests, including neurovascular assessment and range of motion in the uninjured joints, were within normal limits. Recovery has been slower than typical for this fracture, so the treatment course has run somewhat longer than usual. No prior injury to the same wrist or forearm is known from the history provided. Billing records reflect one charge per service with no duplicate entries. Continued orthopedic follow-up and a home exercise program are recommended, with reassessment at the next scheduled visit.
